name: ⚔ Waves Gamer | Java + Bedrock Crossplay | Survival · OneBlock · Lifesteal
description:
Waves Gamer is a small, UK-hosted Minecraft network built around one idea: everything you get here, you earn by playing. There is no rank store, no pay-to-win crate, and nothing on this server can be bought with real money.

Java and Bedrock players share the same worlds. On Java, add play.mc.wavesgamer.com and you are in — any version from 1.7 right through to the current release works, so you do not need to change your launcher or downgrade to play with friends. On Bedrock, phone, tablet, Xbox and Switch players use the same address with port 19132. There is no whitelist and no application form. You join and you play.

SURVIVAL — our main world is a full survival SMP with a player-driven economy. Take a job with /jobs and get paid for the mining, farming or building you were doing anyway. Sell to player shops, level your skills, and claim your base with a golden shovel so nobody can touch it. Land claims are free and unlimited in size within your claim blocks, and every block change is logged, so if something does go wrong staff can roll it back and see exactly who did it.

ONEBLOCK — start on a single block floating in the void. Break it, and it comes back as something else. Mine your way through 19 phases, from plains and winter through ocean, jungle, desert, the nether and the deep dark, building an island out of nothing but what that one block gives you.

LIFESTEAL — kill a player and take one of their hearts; lose all of yours and you are out until someone revives you. No land claims, and a 5,000-block world border so players actually meet. Combat logging is blocked, so nobody escapes a fight by quitting.

PVP ARENA AND PARKOUR — a stone colosseum where you keep your inventory when you die, and a 110-jump parkour course with checkpoints.
